name_title: Concetto Spaziale – Green Canvas with Two Cuts
description: A minimalist abstract artwork featuring a vibrant green canvas with two diagonal slashes or cuts made through the surface, creating a three-dimensional effect. The cuts reveal dark shadows beneath, adding depth and contrast. The work is displayed in a sleek black frame against a white background. This style is highly reminiscent of Lucio Fontana's 'Concetto Spaziale, Attese' (Spatial Concept, Waiting) series, characterized by deliberate cuts in monochromatic canvases.
